# Kukureku PDF

> Free private PDF tools that run in the browser.

Kukureku PDF is a browser-based PDF workspace at https://kukureku.com. The current tools are designed to process supported files locally on the user's device rather than upload document contents for server-side conversion. No Kukureku account is required for the current launch tools.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://kukureku.com/
- About: https://kukureku.com/about
- Trust Center: https://kukureku.com/trust
- Private PDF processing guide: https://kukureku.com/guides/private-pdf-tools
- Privacy Policy: https://kukureku.com/privacy
- Terms: https://kukureku.com/terms
- Public source repository: https://github.com/hamsa-tech26/pdfnova

## Current tools

- Merge PDF: https://kukureku.com/merge-pdf
- Split PDF: https://kukureku.com/split-pdf
- Compress PDF: https://kukureku.com/compress-pdf
- PDF to Word: https://kukureku.com/pdf-to-word
- Word to PDF: https://kukureku.com/word-to-pdf
- JPG to PDF: https://kukureku.com/jpg-to-pdf
- PDF to JPG: https://kukureku.com/pdf-to-jpg
- Organize PDF: https://kukureku.com/organize-pdf
- Watermark PDF: https://kukureku.com/watermark-pdf
- Unlock PDF: https://kukureku.com/unlock-pdf

## Important product facts

- Current supported document workflows run locally in the browser.
- Website analytics are separate from document processing and are disclosed in the Privacy Policy.
- Most PDF and DOCX workflows currently use a 25 MB input limit; individual tool pages describe their exact limits.
- PDF to Word is intended for selectable-text PDFs; scanned pages require OCR.
- Word to PDF focuses on readable text, headings, lists, and basic tables rather than exact Microsoft Word layout reproduction.
- Unlock PDF should only be used for documents the user owns or is authorized to modify.
- Planned AI features are not part of the current public launch.
